study_notes.title: Magnetism: The Force of Attraction

definitions.Magnet: A substance that attracts iron and steel.
definitions.Non_Magnetic: Copper, Aluminum, Zinc, Lead, Wood, Plastic.

laws_and_properties.visual_reference: [IMAGE_021: Bar magnet with iron filings showing field lines]
laws_and_properties.Law_of_Magnetism: Like poles repel; Unlike poles attract.
laws_and_properties.Lines_of_Force: Run from North to South. They never cross.
laws_and_properties.Strongest_Point: Magnetic force is highest at the poles.
laws_and_properties.Neutral_Point: The area between two like poles where the force is zero.

study_notes.earth_as_a_magnet: The Earth has a magnetic field. A freely suspended magnet always rests North-South.

IMAGE_021.description: A bar magnet with curved arrows flowing from the 'N' end to the 'S' end.
